description_compelling: A material rewrite of who gets taxed and what gets spent — emergency budgets, austerity packages, tax-code overhauls, defense or welfare reorderings. Debt-to-GDP, fiscal-capacity, and external-interest-burden measures pressure the move months to years out. Common in countries returning from IMF programs, in mid-cycle democracies, and during war or pandemic shocks.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
